tailoring.headline: Senior Java Developer | Spring Boot, REST APIs & Microservices | E-Commerce Platforms
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: [Post] We're Hiring | B2B Senior Developer – Salesforce Commerce Cloud
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the B2B Senior Developer position at Subharti Sagar. With over 5 years of professional experience building and scaling enterprise B2B and B2C e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep backend expertise in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, and complex platform integrations.

bullets.label: Enterprise B2B Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and implemented robust backend functionality on enterprise e-commerce platforms using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing, and B2B customer data management following platform best practices.

bullets.label: REST APIs & Integrations
bullets.text: Developed and exposed REST Web Services and headless APIs for storefront and third-party consumers, engineering API migrations and data pipelines across complex enterprise system landscapes.

bullets.label: Performance & Microservices
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed, supported production troubleshooting, and maintained code quality through automated unit testing and code reviews.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & DevOps
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles within agile DevOps workflows, collaborating closely with international technical teams, product owners, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable e-commerce solutions.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit, and am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026 (earliest start date: 16 December 2026). I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my senior backend and e-commerce platform experience aligns with your engineering goals.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to bring my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce and backend development expertise to Subharti Sagar. Your focus on robust B2B platforms matches my core strengths in designing scalable Java and Spring architectures, high-performance REST APIs, and complex system integrations within fast-paced agile environments.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of senior backend and enterprise e-commerce platform experience in Java, Spring, REST APIs, and integrations to drive scalable technical delivery at Subharti Sagar.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I am an experienced Senior Developer with 5+ years building enterprise e-commerce platforms using Java, Spring, and robust REST API integrations. With my background at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I would love to contribute to Subharti Sagar. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: B2B Senior Developer – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the B2B Senior Developer position at Subharti Sagar. With over 5 years of professional backend experience building and scaling enterprise e-commerce platforms using Java, Spring, and RESTful APIs at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am well-equipped to contribute to your engineering team.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit and am available starting 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing my application with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
